name: com.wouterapts.openik
description: Inverse kinematics solvers and joint constraints for Unity.

samples.description: Models, materials, textures, terrain, and shared scene assets used by the other OpenIK samples. Import this first; the scene samples reference these assets. Requires the Universal Render Pipeline (URP).
Basic OpenIK chain scenes and constraint playground setups. Requires the Shared Assets sample and the Universal Render Pipeline (URP).
Robotic arm showcase using OpenIK solvers, constraints, paint buckets, and a canvas. Requires the Shared Assets sample and the Universal Render Pipeline (URP).
Procedural spider leg placement sample using OpenIK chains and constraints. Requires the Shared Assets sample and the Universal Render Pipeline (URP).
